summary: Defines an experimental scheme for Internet encapsulation, in which IP datagrams get an extra header and are routed between encapsulators and decapsulators along flows. The authors were Woodburn and Mills. It is an Experimental protocol, version 1.

eli5.summary: It puts a letter inside a bigger envelope for a part of the trip, and a helper at the other end removes the extra envelope.

questions: what is the internet encapsulation protocol
